title: UpGrad completes Unacademy acquisition at $206m valuation
summary_en: The all-stock deal combines Unacademy’s online test-preparation and consumer-learning businesses with upGrad’s higher education and upskilling portfolio.
author: Abhishek Nair

title: Worsening ELT declines signal market “restructuring”
summary_en: A second consecutive year of global English language teaching (ELT) declines mark the emergence of a new sector structure, say experts.
author: Polly Nash
